title: Relay tuner
description: Sweep the FM radio band or seek the next station and watch the carrier lock.

title: Film proof
description: Compare three film stocks on the same landscape and check the framing with a thirds grid.

title: Channel inbox
description: Catch up on timestamped messages across three desk channels and acknowledge each thread.

title: Switchboard
description: Light the entire board. Each pad flips its neighbors as well as itself.

title: Fare machine
description: Choose a fare zone and party size, then issue a ticket with the calculated total.

title: Expedition pack
description: Fit supplies into a ten-kilogram pack and swap items when space runs short.

title: Palette lab
description: Compare spot inks across five tints and copy the CSS for your pick.

title: Desk command launcher
description: Tune a relay, mute alerts, or print a status report from a searchable command palette.

title: Studio pass
description: Enter a sample code to issue a barcoded day pass and see how an invalid code is handled.

title: Power mixer
description: Divvy up generator power across three circuits and see how much capacity remains.

title: Shift roster
description: Browse studio crews, claim an open shift, and hand the seat back.

title: Clip timeline
description: Trim a field recording from either end and see the length of the selected clip.

title: Crew profile
description: Edit a crew member’s name and shift availability, then save the changes to their ID.

title: Station file browser
description: Explore the ferry desk’s folders and inspect the source for each route and shift file.

title: Broadcast composer
description: Choose a channel, edit a short bulletin, and post it to the station’s local board.

title: Glyph match
description: Turn over cards and find four matching pairs in a shuffled deck.

title: Departure board
description: Switch platforms and advance the clock to see the next trains roll onto the board.

title: Telemetry inspector
description: Inspect rooftop temperature and wind readings over three time windows.

title: Studio booking
description: Name a session, pick an available date and time, and edit the reservation.

title: Type specimen
description: Set your own sample text, swap typefaces, and size the lettering against a ruler.

title: Print checkout
description: Choose a paper stock and edition quantity, then place a sample print order.

title: Shift handoff
description: Add a task to the handoff checklist and track how much of the shift is ready.

title: Notification routing
description: Choose where alerts go and test how routine and priority messages behave during quiet hours.

title: Dice tray
description: Pick a die, roll a handful, and keep the last four scores.

title: Route planner
description: Choose a destination and compare the local and express routes on a line diagram.

title: Sector atlas
description: Follow three observatories across a globe, select a site, and switch to a flat chart.

title: Dispatch queue
description: Inspect a pickup, send its van, and work through the delivery run in any order.

title: Workshop feedback
description: Rate a workshop, add an optional note, and record the response.

title: Review queue
description: Read incoming change requests, approve or return each one, and undo a decision.

title: Crew directory
description: Find a crew member by name or district, inspect their radio channel, and save favorites.

title: Reaction clock
description: Wait for the cue and try to beat your fastest reaction time.

title: Freight scale
description: Weigh a pallet, tare the scale, and add crates to measure their net weight.
